lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A sub-regular grid of high-luminance circular spots posterior to the gill slits, arranged in approximately four identifiable vertical columns and three primary horizontal rows along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: High-intensity spots are centered within faint, diffuse vertical bands of elevated luminance that cross the lateral flank perpendicular to the main body axis.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal linear features are visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp pixel intensity gradient from light on the dorsal edge to shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of small, circular high-luminance blobs concentrated primarily on the lower half of the first dorsal fin's trailing surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Several small, elongated dark pixel clusters indicative of commensal fish (remoras) are visible swimming in close proximity to the ventral surface of the shark.
